supporting_observations.claim: The alerted periodic connections are to update.stockpilot.com through the explicit proxy. The proxy records show successful CONNECTs at 13:39:11, 13:43:59, 13:48:59, 13:53:54, 13:59:21, 14:04:10, and 14:08:46—roughly five-minute intervals.

The corresponding network events are attributed by Windows filtering and Sysmon to C:\Program Files\StockPilot\stockpilotupd.exe (PID 4268) connecting to the proxy, including at 13:43:59, 13:48:59, 13:53:54, 13:59:21, 14:04:10, and 14:08:46.

The destination, executable path, and approximately five-minute cadence match the inventory description of the approved StockPilot updater checking update.stockpilot.com about every five minutes; this supports a benign explanation for the alerted activity.

The updater process was recorded as starting with Chrome as its parent, whose command line opened https://stackoverflow.com/. This is unusual context, but the records do not establish that the updater or its connections were malicious.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records document the periodic StockPilot connections from 13:39:11 through 14:08:46, but do not show an alerted connection before 13:39:11.
The proxy records show CONNECTs to the updater host, not the contents of the updater's encrypted application exchange.
The records do not provide a file hash or signature validation for stockpilotupd.exe.
The proxy CONNECT records report a Chrome user agent while endpoint network telemetry attributes the connections to stockpilotupd.exe; the supplied evidence does not explain that discrepancy.
claims_not_established: Whether stockpilotupd.exe is an authentic, unmodified approved updater.
Why Chrome is recorded as the updater process's parent.
Whether connections before the first supplied StockPilot connection occurred during the alert window.
unrelated_findings: WS-EBROOKS-01 launched the Cisco AnyConnect VPN UI and then made a connection to api-17.duosecurity.com. The inventory states there is no VPN; this is separate from the StockPilot updater activity and merits separate review. Records: T196-00250, T196-00251, T196-00252, T196-00253.

FILE-BLU-01 recorded an SMB connection from WS-EBROOKS-01 followed by an NTLM network logon as ANONYMOUS LOGON. This is outside the alerted connection pattern and merits separate review. Records: T196-00415, T196-00419.
